title: 印花产品图库
reason: Share owner set folder permission that requires WeCom/WeDrive login (auth_type=2). Page shows "Permission set for the folder. Log in to view." No file-list API is called and download_url is empty. Cannot list or download without login.
how_to_unblock: Ask 庄耀骏 @广州展发纺织 to change share permission to「任何人可查看/下载」(anyone with the link), then re-run this script.
Or open a browser session, sign in to enterprise WeChat / WeDrive once (interactive), then extend this script to reuse that session — not suitable for unattended cron without stored login.
Or manually export/zip the folder from WeDrive and drop files into projects/印花产品图库/images/.
